name: AnimatedNumber
label: Animated number
description: A number that counts to its value: count-up on mount, eased tweens on change, tabular digits that never jitter.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to display. Changing it tweens the display from the previous value.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places shown throughout the tween and at rest. Ignored when `format` is set.

props.name: format
props.description:
Formats the displayed number — currency, units, compact notation. Called
on every animation frame, so keep it pure and cheap.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the number is written in when no `format` is given,
such as `de-DE` (`1.234,5`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's,
else `en-US`.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Tween length in ms. Defaults to the shared `MOTION_COUNT_UP_MS` constant;
an animation pace, so the tween is skipped entirely under reduced motion.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description: Counts up from zero on first render. Turn off to arrive settled and animate only on later changes.
